protocol.normalization: identical to P2T: cumulative-max density, endpoint density normalization, then 10/90 density crossings mapped to exposure coordinates 0/1
protocol.validation: leave one stock out; pointwise median of the other two normalized shapes predicts the held stock
protocol.final_candidate: pointwise median of all three normalized stock shapes
protocol.uncertainty_envelope: pointwise minimum and maximum of all three normalized stock shapes

allowed_actions: Compile and serialize one source-domain normalized template and uncertainty envelope.
Evaluate only leave-one-stock-out source-shape prediction against the frozen canonical line.
Retain the template only if aggregate, tail and every-channel gates pass.
forbidden_actions: Do not tune the grid, baseline, channel weights or gates after formal execution.
Do not reopen P2R mapping, infer an exposure gauge or apply the template to photographs.
Do not call the template a stock response, calibrated characteristic curve or product profile.
claim_ceiling: Gauge-free source-document shape-template diagnostic across three Kodak VISION3 technical graphs; not a layer-exposure mapping, stock calibration, roll measurement or image operator.
